title: Report: FTC probes Anthropic, OpenAI after Trump dismissed AI fears as “hoax”
script:
The FTC is investigating OpenAI and Anthropic over potential security failures.
Regulators want to know if security incidents actually harmed American users.
This probe follows President Donald Trump dismissing AI fears as a hoax.
The FTC may fine these labs for failing to report data breaches.
Officials are now pressuring these labs to disclose internal safety logs.
OpenAI and Anthropic now face heightened scrutiny from federal regulators.
Would you trust these labs with your personal data?
